caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic bird figurine positioned centrally on a light beige background with a thin, hand-drawn rectangular border near the edges of the paper. The bird, perched atop a small, multi-tiered pedestal, faces partially to the viewer’s left. The bird’s body is primarily yellow with a gradient of green on its wings, and it has a visible red accent along the length of its tail and wingtips. The beak is dark brown and the bird’s eye is clearly defined with a dark pupil and a surrounding reddish-orange ring. The pedestal supporting the bird is colored in neutral, stone-like tones of gray and beige. There are no other objects or decorations within the composition, and the space around the figurine is left empty. The drawing is signed "MINA LOWRY" in the lower left corner outside the border.
title: Chalkware Parrot
